title: chore(totals): fix a repeated word in a comment
body:
## Summary
Remove the repeated word 'the' from the comment in total() in src/totals.py.

## Rationale
The duplicated word is a typo that makes the comment read incorrectly.

## Testing
Validation plan: inspect the edited comment in src/totals.py; no test is added for a comment.

## Limitations
Only this comment is edited; other comments in src/totals.py have not been reviewed.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/totals.py b/src/totals.py
--- a/src/totals.py
+++ b/src/totals.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 def total(prices):
-    # Add up the the prices.
+    # Add up the prices.
     t = 0
     for price in prices:
         t += price
